raw.title: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Noise Canceling Headphones, Black + Wood Headphone Stand
raw.description: The Sony WH-1000XM5 is a pair of industry-leading wireless noise-canceling headphones in black, bundled with a Deco Gear wood headphone display stand. These headphones feature two processors controlling eight microphones for superior noise cancellation and call quality. They offer up to 30 hours of battery life with quick charging, a lightweight design with soft fit leather, and support for High-Resolution Audio. The bundle includes a carrying case, headphone cable, and a USB charging cable, along with a secure wooden tabletop holder for storage.

raw.title: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite
raw.description: Experience superior reading with the Amazon Kindle Paperwhite. This 12th Generation device boasts a faster processor for 20% improved performance and 25% faster page turns. Its glare-free 7-inch display offers a higher contrast ratio for crisp, clear text, and can be adjusted from white to amber to suit any lighting condition, from bright sunlight to the dark. Personalize your reading by adjusting text size and boldness. Designed for focused reading, it lacks distracting apps and notifications. The battery lasts up to 12 weeks on a single USB-C charge, and the device is waterproof for worry-free use anywhere. Access over 15 million titles from the Kindle Store, with options for Kindle Unlimited and Amazon Kids+.

raw.title: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024)
raw.description: The Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024) is a high-performance e-reader featuring a next-generation 7” glare-free display. Designed for an immersive reading experience, it includes an auto-adjusting front light for versatility in any lighting condition and a distraction-free interface. This edition offers 32 GB of storage, wireless charging capabilities, and is waterproof, making it ideal for travel or reading by the pool. With 20% faster performance and a battery life lasting up to 12 weeks via USB-C, it provides a seamless and long-lasting reading experience.

rows.title: Samsung T7 Portable SSD 1TB USB 3.2 Gen 2 External Solid State Drive

raw.title: Samsung T7 Portable SSD 1TB USB 3.2 Gen 2 External Solid State Drive
raw.description: The Samsung T7 is a compact and secure portable SSD offering 1TB of storage in a sleek Titan Gray aluminum unibody. Designed for high performance, it utilizes PCIe NVMe technology to deliver read speeds up to 1050 MB/s and write speeds up to 1000 MB/s via a USB 3.2 Gen 2 interface. It ensures data security with 256-bit AES hardware encryption and password protection. The drive is highly compatible with Windows, Mac, Android, and gaming consoles, and specifically supports Apple iPhone 15 series for ProRes video recording. Its durable, lightweight design is drop-resistant up to 6.6 feet and includes Dynamic Thermal Guard technology to prevent overheating.

raw.title: T7 Shield Portable SSD
raw.description: The Samsung T7 Shield (MU-PE1T0S/AM) is a rugged, portable external solid-state drive (SSD) featuring 1 TB of storage. Designed for high performance and durability, it offers fast data transfer speeds via a USB 3.2 Gen 2 interface with a USB-C connector, reaching maximum data transfer rates of 1050 MB/s. The drive is built to withstand harsh environments with an IP65 rating for water and dust resistance, a shock-resistant design, and a Dynamic Thermal Guard to manage heat. For security, it includes 256-bit AES hardware encryption. The drive comes in black and includes both USB-C to USB-C and USB-C to USB-A cables for versatile connectivity across PCs, Macs, and mobile devices.

rows.title: Logitech MX Master 3S Performance Wireless Mouse

raw.title: Logitech MX Master 3S Performance Wireless Mouse
raw.description: This is an ergonomic, wireless mouse from Logitech, model MX Master 3S, in black. It features ultra-fast scrolling with its MagSpeed electromagnetic scroll wheel, which is 90% faster, 87% more precise, and ultra-quiet. The mouse has quiet click buttons that provide a satisfying tactile feel with 90% less noise. It also boasts an 8K DPI optical sensor for next-gen responsiveness on any surface, including glass. The ergonomic design supports natural wrist posture, and the thumb controls are optimally placed. Users can customize buttons and optimize workflows with app-specific profiles using the Logi Options+ app. The mouse supports Flow cross-computer control, allowing seamless transfer of text, images, and files between Windows and macOS. It can connect to up to 3 devices via Bluetooth across Windows, macOS, Chrome OS, and Linux. The mouse stays powered for up to 70 days on a full charge and provides 3 hours of use from a one-minute quick charge.

raw.title: Artisan Series Tilt-head Stand Mixer
raw.description: This KitchenAid Artisan Series stand mixer is designed for durability and performance, featuring a 5-quart stainless steel bowl with a comfortable handle, capable of mixing up to 9 dozen cookies in a single batch. Its tilt-head design allows for easy ingredient addition and accessory attachment, while 10 speeds cater to a wide range of tasks from gentle stirring to whipping. The mixer boasts a glossy, deep red finish and a sturdy, stable base. It is also compatible with over 10 optional hub-powered attachments, expanding its versatility for making pasta, burgers, ice cream, and more. The product is suitable for adult users and is a physical product. The materials include metal construction and a stainless steel bowl, and it comes in a vibrant Empire Red color.

raw.title: KitchenAid Artisan Series 5-Quart Tilt-Head Stand Mixer
raw.description: The KitchenAid Artisan Series 5 Quart Tilt-Head Stand Mixer is a durable and versatile kitchen appliance designed to handle a wide variety of recipes. It features 10 speeds for precise mixing, from gentle stirring to vigorous whipping. The tilt-head design allows for easy access to the bowl and attachments, while the 5-quart stainless steel bowl is spacious enough for large batches and is dishwasher-safe. With over 20 color options, it can complement any kitchen decor. The mixer is also compatible with over 10 optional hub-powered attachments, expanding its functionality for tasks like making pasta, grinding meat, or creating ice cream. Built with a durable metal construction and 59 touchpoints around the bowl, it ensures excellent mixing results.
